as supplemented through August 8, 2017, which are included herein. Sections of the
1994 Code, as updated, not listed herein have been omitted as repealed, superseded,
obsolete or not of a general and permanent nature. For the location of ordinances
adopted subsequent thereto, see the table immediately following this table.
